A Guide to the 4 Caucuses That Could Shape the Democratic House

Democrats are preparing to take control of the House of Representatives with a substantially larger majority and an influx of new members who cover every corner of the party’s “big tent. ” Incoming Democratic freshman include several democratic socialists and even more moderates who won in competitive and Republican-leaning districts.
